widgets.name: Park Chess
widgets.summary: Casual chess with your friends, on a wooden table in the park.
about: Sit down on a bench as White or Black, and anyone else in the room can watch. Moves are saved in the room, so a game can go on for days: close it, come back tomorrow, and the board is where you left it.
Every move is checked by everyone's copy of the game, so nobody can sneak in an illegal move or play out of turn. Offer a draw, resign, or hit Play again for a rematch with the colours swapped.

widgets.name: Drawpile
widgets.summary: Paint together on one canvas, with real brushes and layers.
about: Open Drawpile's painting app with everyone in the room: real brushes, layers, a colour wheel and a chat, all on one shared canvas. It runs in its own window, on Nether's Drawpile server.

Everyone who opens it joins the same canvas, and it's ready the moment anyone opens it. The canvas isn't end-to-end encrypted. It stays when everyone leaves; a canvas nobody uses for 14 days is removed, so save your drawing from the File menu to keep a copy.
widgets.host: web.drawpile.net, opened from vommet.app; canvas on drawpile.nether.im

notices.text: The canvas isn't end-to-end encrypted, even in an encrypted room. Nether's moderators can see it.
A canvas nobody uses for 14 days is removed. Save yours from the File menu to keep a copy.

widgets.name: Draw
widgets.summary: Draw with your friends over MatrixRTC.
about: Inspired by a late night of drawing doodles on a Monopoly table in Tabletop Simulator: a simple widget for drawing with your friends over MatrixRTC. Strokes are saved in the Matrix room, so you can keep coming back to it and adding more drawings.

widgets.name: Neoboard
widgets.summary: A collaborative whiteboard for Matrix rooms.
about: Collaborate with your peers in real time, while keeping full control of your data and keeping it secure with end-to-end encryption.

widgets.name: Paperchat
about: A fork of an existing project, with quick support for the Matrix widget API hacked in. Its author says it's not particularly polished, but fun to play with for a little while.

widgets.name: Watch Party
widgets.summary: Watch YouTube videos together over MatrixRTC.
about: Watch YouTube videos with your friends over MatrixRTC. Still in alpha.
